appendices_or_supplements: No supplement was bundled with the retrieved PDF. The article points to a separate abbreviation supplement for the series.
coverage_decision: All substantive sections and all five main-text tables were included. No figures or algorithms were present. The bibliography was used to build the separate reference task queue rather than treated as evidence.
omissions_and_reasons: Reference-list entries were not atomized because citations are provenance infrastructure rather than evidence atoms.
No screenshots were embedded because every table could be reconstructed reliably from parsed text and visual inspection.
The external abbreviation supplement was not available in the source folder and does not alter the evidence interpretation.
source_conflicts: The abstract states a literature-search cutoff of 10 December 2019, while the body reports a selected-source search on 10 June 2019 and a PubMed search on 28 June 2019. The source does not reconcile these dates.
secondary_source_guardrail: Trial, cohort, surveillance, and guideline findings reported by this review remain secondary reports anchored to this review. Primary-study atoms require direct reading of the cited primary publication.

external_currency_check.reason: SEA protocol requires recency verification for clinical practice information when feasible.
